Reuse ChatMessage feedback controls with optional counts/read-only mode, keep shared rating projection and mutation owners. No new Action/tool. Extend existing LiveView integration coverage for multiple actors, vote change and persistence. Existing PR A UX/E2E gates continue.

Implemented approved inline reaction UI. ChatMessage feedback buttons accept optional aggregate count and read_only mode; only viewer feedback controls selected/aria-pressed state. Channel History shows count adjacent to each thumb, including read-only external-message spans, and removes separate summary paragraph. Existing countless callers retain their behavior. Storybook assistant variants show counts with/without viewer vote. Browser Storybook localhost:4000 unavailable (connection-error page); final visual approval/E2E remains pending. All changes uncommitted.
